column2: Visitors must shape earthenware on the Thu Bon riverbank while stretching silk over frames to make Hoi An Old Town lanterns.
Ly Son Garlic & the Hoang Sa Flotilla
Visitors must pile coral sand to grow lone garlic on an ancient volcanic crater and build the boats for the Hoang Sa soldiers' send-off ritual.
The martial spirit of Tay Son - Binh Dinh! Draw 1 Skill Card and keep it secret in your hand to play at the right tactical moment.
Bamboo scaffolds on the swiftlet island & Agarwood chisels
Visitors must sail to Hon Noi island to harvest cliff-side swiftlet nests and craft Khanh Hoa agarwood.
Visitors must walk backwards around the clay platform to shape a Cham pot without a wheel and fire it in the open with straw and wood.
Visitors must ferment charcoal-grey anchovies with fine salt in wooden barrels and pour the prime sauce into old clay jars.
Visitors must split bamboo strips, bend the star frame and glue cellophane into a Mid-Autumn lantern.
Visitors must grate coconut flesh, press out rich cream, simmer it with malt on a wood fire and hand-wrap the candy in corn-husk paper.
Visitors must channel seawater into crystallizing fields under the blazing sun and rake up salt mounds that sparkle like crystal.
Ca Mau Cape Eco Shrimp Ponds
Visitors must run the aerator paddles of an eco tiger-shrimp farm under the mangrove canopy of Ca Mau Cape.
Phu Quoc Pearl Island (Fish Sauce & Pearls)
Visitors must cross the sea to Phu Quoc Pearl Island to ferment anchovy sauce in litsea wood barrels and harvest sea pearls.
Cai Rang Floating Market - Can Tho
From Phu Quoc Island you dock at the bustling Cai Rang Floating Market, where boats hang their "beo" poles! Stop by to buy Tool Cards for the journey back north.
Sa Dec Flower Village & Dinh Yen Mats
Bamboo racks on water & Mat-pressing table
Visitors must row a skiff between floating racks of pompom chrysanthemums and weave flowered Dinh Yen night-market mats.
Tan Chau Silk Village - Chau Doc
Visitors must crush mac nua fruit to dye Lanh My A silk a mysterious glossy black and dry it in the fields along the Tien River.
Visitors must steam double-layer rice paper over glowing embers, grill it until it puffs and stay up to catch the night dew at the foot of Ba Den Mountain.
Conquer the gateway to the great highland forests! Draw 1 Skill Card to hold a tactical privilege.
Visitors must run a high-tech greenhouse system on the Lam Vien plateau to tend strawberries and hydrangeas.
Visitors must harvest ripe Robusta cherries beside a communal Rong House and roast and grind a fragrant batch of coffee.
Visitors must weave Ba Na brocade patterns under the soaring Rong House roof and tune the gong ensemble of the great forest.
Visitors must grind fragrant Khe Sanh Arabica beans and collect Truong Son wild honey without being stung.
Follow the majestic Truong Son range! Draw 1 Event Card and carry out its effect immediately.
The Northwest highland market overflows with peach blossoms and brocade! A Tool Card supply station before you close the loop back to the capital.
Pieu Scarves & Thai Xoe Dance of Son La
Visitors must join hands in the xoe circle dance with Thai girls and weave a pieu scarf embroidered with vivid patterns.
Muong Thanh Valley - Dien Bien Rice
Visitors must join the villagers in reaping golden rice on the Muong Thanh fields and bind it into fragrant armfuls of straw.
Sa Pa Rice Terraces & H'Mong Brocade
Visitors must dip linen cloth in indigo beside the drying rack and admire the golden terraces at the foot of Fansipan.
Tan Cuong Tea Hills & Van Phuc Silk
Visitors must pick "one bud, two leaves" tea on lush green hills and weave silk right at the northern gateway to the capital.
Raw materials are scarce! All Tool Cards at the supply stations double in price (x2) for 1 round.
Tool Card prices x2 for 1 round!
Fair weather brings brisk sales of farm goods and handicrafts! Double (x2) the service fee collected when someone steps onto your land this round.
A storm damages the craft village workshops. You must pay 50 dong to the Bank to repair your facilities.
Domestic and international visitors flock to the festival to buy specialties! You receive a 100 dong bonus from the Bank.
Receive a +100 dong bonus from the Bank
Eco-friendly craft products are exported successfully! Receive 35 dong for each Landmark Tile you own (at least 60 dong).
Receive export dividends from the Bank
Your craft product reaches 5-star OCOP standard! The Bank rewards you 120 dong to expand production.
Your traditional craft village is honored as cultural heritage! Receive 1 free random Tool Card and +50 dong.
